construction_rule: Create isolated candidate Skill directories by byte-copying the exact v3 SKILL.md sources and shared references declared here. No rewriting, synthesis, summarization, frontmatter substitution, or semantic augmentation is permitted.

byte_accounting.activation_surface_bytes: UTF-8 byte length of each successfully host-read candidate SKILL.md; reported per trial and candidate.
byte_accounting.loaded_reference_bytes: UTF-8 byte sum of unique successfully host-read candidate reference files; retained as diagnostic only and not used for v3 material selection.
byte_accounting.observed_context_bytes: UTF-8 byte sum of unique successfully host-read candidate SKILL.md files plus unique successfully host-read candidate reference files in the trial. This candidate-sensitive host-trace measure drives v3 context comparison.
byte_accounting.deduplication: Count each materialized candidate path at most once per trial, even when the host reads it repeatedly.
byte_accounting.trace_requirement: Only successful reads of files inside the materialized candidate Skill root count. Model self-report without an observed successful host read does not count.
byte_accounting.token_claim: Byte counts are deterministic evidence derived from host traces and must not be described as exact tokens.
